title: This guy apparently made this open world 2x the size of Skyrim with Fable 5.2 + Tripo in just a few days
author: Upstairs_Tone_4227
selftext:
Don’t get me wrong the art and creative direction is clearly not there but in terms of raw scale + volume of assets, it seemed pretty impressive to me.

\- 12x12km world that looks relatively filled out   
\- multiple cities and towns which went through multiple rounds of iteration   
\- 400 3d assets, 50 rigged 3d models some of which look pretty solid. Rigging + animation is still pretty bad but still impresses me just on volume  
\- 544 voice lines and 772 sound fx. Voice acting actually sounds good. 11labs v4 most likely

I guess I’m skeptical how this could be done in just a few days. Maybe if you ran 5 ultra accounts with as many fable 5.2 and opus 5.5 subagents your limits and your PC could handle. 

The fact it’s an ad for Tesana and Tripo is what makes me the most skeptical though. Anyone recognize any of these models from asset packs?

comments.author: dilberry
comments.body:
More lies. “Never coded in my life”

Guy quit his job to make games. 

Long structured X nonsense. 100% astroturfing and paid shilling.

comments.author: joran213
comments.body: It's easy to produce a massive amount of content with a AI. Making it fun to play is the hard part.

replies.author: Upstairs_Tone_4227
replies.body: Yea it’s the claim that it was all done in a few days is the part I’m skeptical about given even just doing 50 albeit shitty rigs + animations will take a couple hours for each one

replies.author: zmizzy
replies.body: throw enough tokens at it and it's easy peezy to crank out a boatload of slop

replies.author: Time_Cat_5212
replies.body: Yep. The criteria for impressive have shifted away from how hard the hardworking humans worked

replies.author: Ok-Pirate5732
replies.body: yeah at least for me its like, how did this human use AI to create something really cool? Which is why all these one-shot posts do nothing for me, I know the models are insane already, show me how you took advantage of that, not just the sheer amount of slop work it can do by default

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: Exaclty, you can quickly produce more content than you can possibly test or refine. All I see in demos like this is a lack of restraint and a game that will never be finished.

comments.author: JorgitoEstrella
comments.body: Daggerfall is 4000x bigger than Skyrim and it was made in 1996

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body:
Yep. And Daggerfall is 95% empty space.

And it's still probably more fun than this.

comments.author: Need300dollars
comments.body: The X link doesn't lead me to X. But I can say that Fable 5.1 already could do it and that that's a lot of wasted money.

comments.author: Ok-Pirate5732
comments.body:
sheer scale with AI was a novelty when it first became public but it shouldn't be regarded as impressive now. In fact it should be the opposite, because people often use AI scale to cover up the very obvious lack of depth or polish

The cool thing is, AI obviously can greatly speed up processes in the right hand, but "taste" and making a game fun is still entirely human. I hope at least that last part stays true for a while lol

replies.author: Appropriate-Lion9490
replies.body: The last part will always be true

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: the astroturfing posts are getting annoying.

comments.author: Internal-Capital7471
comments.body:
"Everything you see and hear is Code (21B+ tokens) and 3D models"

His post makes him sound like an amateur vibecoder with no clue about game dev.  


Everything is code and 3d models, huh? Real freaking enlightening. Did't know most games weren't made of code and 3d models.

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body:
Yea, I got a chuckle as well. I said to myself "yea, that's pretty much what a game is made of."

And let's do some quick maths. 21 *billion* tokens with Fable 5.2. That's $840,000 with API pricing (output tokens), which is about the only way I could see him using 21b tokens in 48 hours. I don't see a good use of $840k in that video. You could make multiple, full-length, indie titles with commissioned assets for less than that.

But then again, it's also an entirely fake marketing post designed to seem real.
